name: metric-card
title: Metric Card
description: A card showing a metric total, its change against the previous period, a shaded trend line and a three-part breakdown. Dragging across the chart selects a day or a range and the number and captions update.
use: A dashboard needs one headline number that can also be examined day by day or over a dragged range.
avoid: It needs at least twice the longest period of daily data, or the previous-period comparison line goes flat.
a11y: Coverage is strong; the one gap is that selecting a range needs Shift plus arrow keys on the chart slider. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall dark rounded card: a Revenue label with 7D, 30D and 90D pills at the top, a huge white figure below with a small green or red percentage, then a white area chart over a dashed prior line, orange event ticks and three weighted bars with labelled value rows.
behaves: Hovering or dragging on the chart reads a single day or a span, rolling the figure and lighting only that slice while the caption names the compared dates; a dragged range stays until Clear is pressed. The period pills morph the line into a new shape.
customise: Pass label, segment names, daily data, event notes, periods, default period and currency through props; the colour palette and chart geometry are constants in the source.
weight: moderate: An SVG path morph on a requestAnimationFrame loop plus rolling digit transitions.
